# minulo

> minulo (formerly FeedMinus) is an iPhone app that keeps social media usable while hiding Reels, Shorts and recommended posts. DMs, search and posting keep working. Hiding is free.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809352229
- Developer: Ayumu Kitabayashi (Japan)
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). No Android version.
- Languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian
- Services: Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, Reddit, LinkedIn, Snapchat

## What it does
- Opens each service's own website inside the app with Reels, Shorts, Explore tabs and suggested posts hidden. You choose what to hide, one item at a time.
- Uses iPhone Screen Time to stop the official apps you choose from opening; a "Blocked" screen offers "Open minulo" instead.
- Reels or Shorts sent in DMs pause before the endless feed; "Open for 5 min" lets you watch for five minutes.
- Sign-in happens on each service's official page. minulo never receives or stores IDs, passwords or DM contents. Records stay on the device.
- Free: hiding Reels/Shorts/suggested posts, blocking official apps. minulo Pro: schedules, Locked Mode, multiple block lists (yearly plan has a one-month free trial).
